tei:div.tei:p: "$ (401)sgam po pa bkra shis rnam rgyal gyis mdzad pa sgrub pa'i zhal bskos bzhugs so//

(402)bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyun du dge sbyor nyams su len lugs kyi sgrig rim ni/ thog mar gnyid sad ma thag ngo thog gi dran rig ngos bzung nas dar cig de ka'i ngang la skyong ba 'di nyin mo dge sbyor gyi rtsis zin thabs dang phug 'khor yug tu 'gro ba la phan pa'i gnad che shos shig yin/ de nas le lo bzlog phyir mi rtag pa la sogs bsgom nas nges 'byung bskyed la/ skyabs 'gro/ tshogs gsog /sgrib sbyang*/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor rnams 'dun pa drag pos bya/ de nas rlung ro bsal te rlung kha sbyor ci rigs 'dzin pa dang*/ rtog med du 'jog pa yun ring thung skabs dang sbyar la bya/ de nas stong ra dang rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi gsal btab nas gtum mo'i me chung bskyed la brten nas rlung sbyor ba bzhi ldan ci rigs dang*/ 'bar 'dzag gi nyams bskyang spro na'ang cung zad bskyangs pa'i mthar/ rtsa rlung thig le sogs dmigs bcas kyi rim pa ci yang mi bsgom par 'jam rlung bum can 'dzin pa dang*/ sems kyi ngo bo cir yang grub pa med cing cir yang mthong ba med pa nam mkha' bar snang lta bu'i ngang la 'jog pa gnyis phyogs gcig (403)tu skyong ba 'dis thun gyi dngos gzhi byed dgos rgyu yin/ de lta bu'i nyams skyong mi bde bar phyi'i yul snang dang rnam rtog gi 'char sgo rgod na/ 'char sgo bkag pas mi khegs kyang 'char sgo'i rjes su 'brangs nas a 'thas su 'khrul bcug na mi 'ong bas/ zhe 'dod ha cang gi tur po rang min tsam gyi dran pa rgya gang che bskyed/ zhe 'dod 'tshangs pa'i dgag sgrub rung po mi byed par/ rig pa ma yengs pa'i dran pa phra mo'i byar ma shor tsam du gzhan pa'i zhe 'dod med pa/ dmigs pa med pa/ 'du shes med pa/ bsgom rgyu med pa/ blo rtse gtad so ci yang med pa'i rgyun skyong*/ gnad dril na ma yengs tsam gyi ngang nas mi sgom pa'i rgyun bsring ba la sgom skyong ba'i ming btags pa ma gtogs don la ci yang yid la mi byed par de kar sdod pa gcig yin/

don 'di thun dngos gzhi dang thun mtshams thams cad du sgom zhib mor dran mkhas na sgom mkhas dran pa 'di ma shor na glu len bro brdung byas kyang mnyam bzhag gi ngang yin/ dran pa 'di shor na mal sar lus gnad dang lta stangs byas rlung bzung na'ang rjes shes ci rigs su shar ba ma (404)gtogs mnyam bzhag min/ yang dran pa de rnyed na de ma thag ci snang ci shar rjes thob tu 'gyur bas sgom gyi go chod rgyu yin pas gnad 'di go ba gal gyi che shos yin/ de nas thun mtshams la 'jug pa'i thog mar yan lag lnga sbyor dang nā ro drug skor gyi 'khrul 'khor la ci nus 'bad nas lus kyi 'byung bzhi 'du ba cha snyoms/ de la brten nas sems dngas snyigs phyed/ dge sbyor gyi nyams skyong bde ba'i khyad par shin tu che/ de nas chu sbyin dang*/ su rū pa'i gtor ma btang la/ lto g.yo ba sogs ci rigs la 'jug pa'am/ gtor ma brgya rtsa tsha gong du gtong bar 'dod kyang gtong*/ de nas dkon mchog rjes dran dang bza' btung byin rlabs ci rigs pas nas/ zas kyi rnal 'byor la longs spyod pa dang*/ yon sbyong ba'i sngags dang smon lam bya zhing bdud zlog dang smon lam gyi rigs gang la gang 'os bya'o// de nas thun mtshams rnams su chos spyod bcu sogs dge ba'i las ci 'grub la 'bad cing*/ ci snang ci shar thams cad 'khrul snang dang*/ 'khrul snang yang don la grub pa med pa/ rmi lam dang sgyu ma'i bkod pa lta bu bden min brdzun min du thag bcad la/ sdig las dang tshul min du ma song ba'i gnyen po yang yang 'dzin pa la 'bad do// dgong thun gyi skabs su gzhan thams cad 'dra ba la/ yi dam gyi bdag bskyed cung zad rgyas pa re sgom pa dang*/ bzlas pa ci rigs bya zhing gsang sngags spyi gtor 'bul/ gzhan yang yi dam dang chos skyong la sger gyi gtor ma kyang 'bul/ tshogs gsog dang mchod gtor thams cad kyi skabs su dmigs pa rgya che zhing rnam pa gsal ba dang*/

'dod don gyi phrin las bcol ba zhe 'dod kyi 'dun pa drag pos gsol ba 'debs shing phrin las 'chol ba yin/ de nas srod thun gyi mjug tu ku su lu'i mchod sbyin gyi dmigs pa skyong ba byung na dkor dang nyams chags dang lan chags sbyong ba la gzhan (405)ci las kyang nus pa che bar bshad 'dug /de nas gnyid nyal khar rmi lam ci shar yang 'khrul 'byams su ma shor bar rmi lam rmi lam du ngo shes par byed snyams pa'i dran pa shugs can bskyed nas lus kyi byang khog gi nang snying dkyil lta bu'i thad du ngo bo bla ma yin pa la/ rnam pa thig le dkar po nyungs 'bru tsam mam sran ma tsam ci rigs shel gyi ril bu ltar dwangs shing gsal ba'i 'od kyis lus kyi nang dang*/ sgrub khang gi nang dang phyi'i yul khams gsal nus pa tsam gyi thig le de la dmigs rten byas nas nyal na nyams kyi 'od gsal dang gnyid kyi skabs su ngo thog gi dge sbyor skabs re zin pa'i gnad chen po 'byung bar bshad pas de ltar du nyal/ gnyid sad res kyi rmi lam ngos zin ma zin dang dge sbyor gyis zin ma zin blta zhing yang gnyid srab mo byas nas nyal/ de lta bu yang yang byas pas gnyid dang rmi lam du dge sbyor khrid pa la phan chen po thogs pa yin no// spyir gyi dge sbyor byed pa'i mtshams la sdod dus dkor zas dang sgrib can gyi bza' btung thams cad rtog pa zhib mos dpyad la spang*/ rang zas kyang za tshod 'thung tshod tshad la phab pa'i sgrig lam bcur na dge sbyor la spyod bde mi bde dang*/ 'phel 'grib dang lha res 'dre res kyis sems bkol du btub mi btub khyad chen po 'byung bas rnam pa kun tu mi dge bcu spong ba'i tshul khrims bsrung ba/ dbang po'i sgo sdom pa/ bza' btung gi tshod 'dzin pa/ srod tho rangs dang nyin par mi nyal ba la bslab pa rnams kyang re re la gal che zhing*/ mtshams gcod lugs kyang dang por zhag grangs dang zla grangs nyung nge ba zhig sgus dag par bya/

rjes sor de las zhag grangs mang du btang nas bar chad kyi dbang du ma song bar bya dgos/ mtshams bcad rgya snga ma de la ma gzabs par bar chad kyi dbang du btang na rten 'brel 'chug nas phyis kyang de 'dra zhig la blo ngan yang (406)dang dred por 'gro bar 'dug pas mtshams bcad rgya zhag grangs mang rung nyung rung snga ma rang la stabs gzabs shing*/ gza' skar tshes grangs bzang ba la 'jug /zhag grangs kha shas la mtshams dam par btsan thabs su ma zhugs par zhag re bzhin dam du dam du gtong*/ dge sbyor gyi thun kyang zhag re bzhin yun ring du gtong*/ yang mtshams grol ba'i skabs su btsan grol dang dge sbyor gyi sgrig btsan 'jog mi byed par je lhod je lhod du btang nas/ thog mar rang gi grogs mched/ de nas spyil bu'i skor du 'gro ba dang*/ de nas dgon gseb dang*/ de nas yul 'khor du rim pas 'gro dgos pa yin/ mtshams btsan sdom dang btsan grol byas na bar chad 'jug pa la tshegs chen po mi dgos par bshad pas/ de bzhin go bar byas na lag len du 'gel ci thub byed pa gal che/ maṅga laṃ/// /
